role: Groupware scalar notes, tasks, calendar events, contacts and folder/file metadata
known_patches: Integer identity argument schemas; User 1 synthetic operations persona
Concrete optional q/parent filters for note/task/event queries and exact parent/filename filters for folder/file reads
Materialize Event.firstOccurrence from supplied start and original declared default scalar fields
limitations: All 192 source tools are retained; only the nine listed write tools are certified. *_set for Note, Task and Event is insert-only.
schedule_event covers a scalar Event with calendarId/start/duration. Recurrence expansion, participants, invitations, conflict checking and external calendar synchronization are not implemented.
Source Event.calendarId lacks an FK constraint; signed-in source ACLs are incomplete and do not isolate all content by owner.
file_create creates empty metadata with size=0, without bytes. folder_delete hard-deletes instead of moving to trash; move/share effects are unverified.
Original query filter JSON, sort/pagination/anchor and many JMAP batch update/destroy arguments are not implemented; use the documented q and exact parent filters.
Task.uid/uri use source task-auto constants; task status progress has a source enum/type mismatch. These are not unique task IDs or certified status transitions.
Source tasklist_set/calendar_set/notebook_set need ACL/FK handling not exposed consistently; workspace helpers seed existing containers and do not add creation tools.
